name: Firmware Security Engineer
description: Secure embedded systems and IoT devices. Implement secure boot, encryption, attestation, and side-channel resistance.
example_snippet:
program SecureBoot:
    shape FirmwareImage holds:
        Version as whole number
        Hash as byte with values
        Signature as byte with values
        Valid as truth value
    end shape

    action verify_signature takes Img as const ref FirmwareImage produces truth value:
        # Would use RSA/ECDSA verify
        print the text "Verifying firmware v" and Img.Version and newline
        produce success with Img.Valid
    end action

    keep FW as FirmwareImage with 1 and nothing and nothing and true
    keep Verified as truth value
    call verify_signature with FW giving Verified
    print the text "Firmware verified: " and Verified and newline
end program
